reference_sql:
SELECT length(TRIM(sku)) AS sku_length, COUNT(*) AS n_products, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sku <> TRIM(sku)) AS n_padded
FROM products
GROUP BY length(TRIM(sku))
alternatives:
WITH measured AS (  -- one row per product
  SELECT length(TRIM(sku)) AS sku_length,
         CASE WHEN sku <> TRIM(sku) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_padded
  FROM products
)
SELECT sku_length, COUNT(*) AS n_products, SUM(is_padded) AS n_padded
FROM measured
GROUP BY sku_length
SELECT length(TRIM(sku)) AS sku_length, COUNT(*) AS n_products, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE length(sku) <> length(TRIM(sku))) AS n_padded FROM products GROUP BY 1

other_way.sql:
WITH measured AS (  -- one row per product
  SELECT length(TRIM(sku)) AS sku_length,
         CASE WHEN sku <> TRIM(sku) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_padded
  FROM products
)
SELECT sku_length, COUNT(*) AS n_products, SUM(is_padded) AS n_padded
FROM measured
GROUP BY sku_length
other_way.tradeoff: A named step measures and flags each sku once before grouping, while one grouped query with FILTER is shorter.
